title: frontend / payment.captured (v1) data payload
description: An online card payment was CONFIRMED captured by the PSP at the Frontend payments edge, to LOAD stored value (the only online card operation; Round 17, ADR-0011). Published to 'frontend.events' with routing key 'payment.captured'; consumed by Billing (which credits the stored-value ledger and emits the balance fact). The edge emits this from its OUTBOX, so a confirmed payment survives the bus being down. 'paymentId' is the dedupe key for duplicate PSP webhooks.

paymentId.description: PSP/edge payment id. Inbox dedupe key for duplicate webhook deliveries.

provider.description: PSP behind the edge (v1: Mollie). Provider is swappable behind a port.

purpose.description: What the loaded value funds: a wallet top-up or a gift-card purchase.

masterId.description: Canonical masterId of the paying customer. REQUIRED in practice for wallet_topup (the wallet owner); may be present or null for giftcard_purchase (a logged-in buyer, or an anonymous purchase).

amount.description: Captured amount in currency MINOR units (integer cents) (the value loaded). Non-taxable at load (MPV; VAT accounted at spend).

capturedAt.description: When the PSP confirmed capture (RFC3339 UTC).
